t: Titan TTB889SDR_A electric 1/3 sheet sander designed for efficient dry sanding. Provides effective and fine finishes across flat surfaces. The versatile 200W sander handles wood, plastic, metal, fillers, and coated surfaces, making it ideal for various trade and workshop applications. Features 6-speed variable control for precision work, and both hook and loop and clamp fixing options for secure sheet attachment. Integrated dust vacuum facility minimises airborne particles, enhancing workplace cleanliness and user comfort. The soft-grip handle and lightweight 1.5kg design ensure comfort and easy handling during prolonged use, while dust-sealed bearings contribute to the tool's durability and longevity. Includes 2.5m cable, providing ample reach for diverse tasks. Can be only used for dry operation without water or other coolants.
